fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. Fair arrival supplies 198 coins. Trust is seeded to 45 except for the threshold checks (25 for l17). The wallet is set to 20 for l18 and restored after declining. Offer frames use Thursday day 8 at 10:00, due frames Sunday day 11 at 10:00, and final repayment frames Sunday day 18 at 10:00. Friday prayer and night closures are checked between those fixtures. A fresh arrival starts each branch.
method: Real native Godot viewport. Viewport clicks drive fair arrivals, physical walks to Spice row, the loan choices, and the return to the market map.
